description: This reference locates three-phase power-factor capacitor in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented motor control family. A three-phase capacitor assembly provides a documented reactive-power function connected to the power circuit. The schematic needs its connection, switching and protective devices as separate elements. The public library uses HCA113 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
